description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewProperty' that extends 'SugarView' for rendering and managing property view UI within the SuiteCRM's module builder. It handles init and display functionalities, processes request parameters, and renders templates related to module properties.

classes.name: ViewProperty
classes.description: A view class for handling property editing in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder, extending SugarView, initializing and rendering property templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view by calling init().

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for display.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes view properties based on request parameters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the property editing interface using Smarty templates and Ajax.
